literal_layout.rows: Fin H, decoded by finProdFinEquiv.symm as (bit:Fin 2,bond:Fin S); numeric row=bit*S+bond; low q physical wires are bond little-endian, highest local wire is bit
literal_layout.columns: Fin(rankAt (denoteChain C) t); input physical positions are prefix labels a, equivalently (bit=0,bond=a)
literal_layout.core_storage: StoredCore l m rows old bond a, flattened column=bit*m+new bond b
literal_layout.padding: entries with output bond >= actual next rank are exactly zero; no artificial active columns beyond actual rank
literal_layout.sign: literal signed real entries; no absolute-value or phase quotient

interfaces.extract: extract (C:StoredChain n l r) (q t:Nat) (ht:t<n): Run(StoredMatrix (2*2^q) (rankAt (denoteChain C) t))
interfaces.value: denote (extract C q t ht).value = fun row a => activeColumns (denoteChain C) t hB ((ConstructiveIsometryLocal.coordinates q).symm row) a
interfaces.cost: each op bounded by (2*S*rank)*(4*tick.field+2*tick.read+tick.compare)+(2*S*rank+2*S)*(2*tick.read+2*tick.write)+3*(t+1)*tick.read; therefore total <=22*S*rank+8*S+3*(t+1)
interfaces.prefix: stored Positions (2*S) rank has embedding a=Fin.castLE rank_bound a; prefix labels are materialized, not supplied as a free embedding
interfaces.source: public Hermite theorem binders k n L hL:(0<L) t:Fin(n+1); hB and canonicality produced internally from frozen supplier
interfaces.completion_if_ready: completeFrom consumes the actual extract run and actual prefix Positions run; returned stored square matrix refines ConstructiveIsometryLocal.completeStage under coordinates, with supplier plus extraction plus positions plus existing completion polynomialBudget charged

cost_scope.model: selected exact-real stored-word RAM counters; extractor additionally charges selected natural index operations in Op.field as declared overcount category, NOT real arithmetic claims
cost_scope.index_operations: two quotient/remainder operations per extracted cell for row decoding; two multiplication/addition operations per supported cell for stored-core flattening; all <=4*H*rank; core traversal three reads per visited cons node
cost_scope.storage: materialize full nested vectors with existing collect projection/counter passes; supported scalar lookup two reads; padding comparison once per cell
cost_scope.callback: only explicit charged decode/guard/flatten/stored-entry callbacks; no arbitrary scalar callback
excluded: global wire placement and circuit copying
cost_scope.raw_extra_counters: must remain separate from extractor selected-index counters; do not reinterpret raw quotient/remainder theorem as full pipeline quotient/remainder count

regression: source n=0 is one real stage
generic empty train admits no valid stage
deficient noncanonical core extraction allowed but isometry not claimed
non-prefix completion input tested via existing stored completion producer
